title: Richard Shulman - The Bridge To The New Awareness [9nSs]

lines.l: Welcome to Sleep Radio, a free service to help you get to sleep and stay asleep.
I'm John Watson, the manager of Sleep Radio.
A big welcome also to all other radio stations in New Zealand and the USA
who relay our audio stream in their overnight programming.
we trust and pray that the specially selected music that you're about to hear will help you
with your sleeplessness or insomnia the costs of running this service are borne primarily by my
wife and me with some help from some of our wonderful listeners who donate to help keep us
on air there are tips on our website to help you get to sleep based on our personal experiences
You can also donate on our website at sleepradio.co.nz
